title: Pure K9
summary: Pure K9 cards with generic handtraps and staples. Level 5 K9 monsters Normal Summon without Tributing while the opponent holds two or more cards in hand, and pair up for Rank 5 Xyz plays that rank up via Quick-Play Spells.

summary.title: Starters
points: "A Case for K9" searches any K9 monster from the Deck, and Sets a K9 Quick-Play Spell when destroyed.
K9-66a Jokul Special Summons itself alongside another Level 5 from the hand and searches a non-Aqua K9 monster.
K9-66b Lantern Special Summons itself alongside a Level 5 K9 from the GY and searches a K9 Spell or Trap.
K9-17 Izuna sends a K9 card from the Deck to the GY on summon to fuel Lantern, and Special Summons itself from the hand once the opponent uses a hand or GY monster effect.

summary.title: Opening: "A Case for K9" or Jokul + Level 5
steps: Activate "A Case for K9" to add K9-66a Jokul, or Normal Summon K9-17 Izuna to send K9-ØØ Lupis to the GY and pair it with K9-66b Lantern.
Special Summon Jokul with another Level 5 K9 from the hand, then use Jokul to search K9-66b Lantern and Lantern to search a K9 Quick-Play Spell.
Overlay two Level 5 K9 monsters into K9-17 "Ripper", which detaches to search another K9 card and Set K9-X Forced Release or K9-LC Release Restraint for the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Reactive Rank-Ups & K9-ØØ Lupis
summary.text: Whenever the opponent activates a monster effect in the hand or GY, K9-17 Izuna and K9-ØØ Lupis Special Summon themselves, and Lupis can immediately Xyz Summon a K9 Xyz on the opponent's turn. The Quick-Play Spells K9-X Forced Release, K9-LC Release Restraint, and K9-EW Special Release Experiment also rank your Rank 5s up into Rank 9 bosses at Quick-Play speed.

summary.title: Control
points: K9-X "Ripper/M", the Rank 9 boss summoned by a K9 Spell/Trap effect, shuffles two cards from the opponent's GY or banishment into the Deck and negates a monster effect while wiping the field.
K9-17 "Ripper" negates an opposing hand or GY effect while generating K9 searches and Sets.

K9-66X "Jacks" destroys a monster on summon or whenever the opponent uses a hand or GY effect, while K9-ØØ "Hound" banishes a card each Standby Phase and K9-X "Werewolf" attacks once per material and banishes cards in response to the opponent.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: K9-04 Noroi is Forbidden in the TCG. The page's hybrid combo lines add Train, Infinitrack, and Gadget engines, which are omitted in this pure K9 build.
